why: No board needed and everything else reads from it; it also surfaces the two bring-up traps (resets behind the I2C expander, the battery power latch) before any code is written.
Proves build, flash, monitor and recovery on this board before any driver work.
The display and touch resets sit on the expander, so this gates both.
Retires the biggest unknown (SPD2010 QSPI init); everything visible depends on it.
Second half of the screen; needed before LVGL input.
First usable UI layer, built on 22 and 23.
